<span>    color: #2c3e50;</span>
<span>    text-decoration: none;</span>
<span>    transition: color 0.2s;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .toc a:hover { color: #16a085; text-decoration: underline; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  .badge {</span>
<span>    display: inline-block;</span>
<span>    padding: 4px 12px;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 20px;</span>
<span>    font-size: 12px;</span>
<span>    font-weight: bold;</span>
<span>    color: white;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .badge-success { background: #27ae60; }</span>
<span>  .badge-info { background: #3498db; }</span>
<span>  .badge-warning { background: #f39c12; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  .simple-box {</span>
<span>    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e9 0%, #f1f8e9 100%);</span>
<span>    border-right: 5px solid #4caf50;</span>
<span>    padding: 18px 22px;</span>
<span>    margin: 20px 0;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0;</span>
<span>    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.1);</span>

<span>  .simple-box .simple-title {</span>
<span>    color: #2e7d32;</span>
<span>    font-weight: bold;</span>
<span>    font-size: 16px;</span>
<span>    margin-bottom: 10px;</span>
<span>    display: flex;</span>
<span>    align-items: center;</span>
<span>    gap: 8px;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .simple-box .simple-title::before {</span>
<span>    content: "💡";</span>
<span>    font-size: 20px;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  .warning-box {</span>
<span>    background: #fff3cd;</span>
<span>    border-right: 4px solid #f39c12;</span>
<span>    padding: 15px 20px;</span>
<span>    margin: 20px 0;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  .success-box {</span>
<span>    background: #d4edda;</span>
<span>    border-right: 4px solid #27ae60;</span>
<span>    padding: 15px 20px;</span>
<span>    margin: 20px 0;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  .danger-box {</span>
<span>    background: #f8d7da;</span>
<span>    border-right: 4px solid #e74c3c;</span>
<span>    padding: 15px 20px;</span>
<span>    margin: 20px 0;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  .info-box {</span>
<span>    background: #d1ecf1;</span>
<span>    border-right: 4px solid #17a2b8;</span>
<span>    padding: 15px 20px;</span>

<span></span>
<span>  hr {</span>
<span>    border: none;</span>

<span>  }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  .file-tree {</span>
<span>    background: #2c3e50;</span>
<span>    color: #ecf0f1;</span>

<span>    border-radius: 8px;</span>
<span>    direction: ltr;</span>
<span>    text-align: left;</span>

<span>  }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  .flow-diagram {</span>

<span>    margin: 20px 0;</span>
<span>    text-align: center;</span>
<span>    font-family: 'Consolas', monospace;</span>

<span></span>
<span>  .step-card {</span>
<span>    background: white;</span>
<span>    border: 2px solid #16a085;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 10px;</span>
<span>    padding: 15px 20px;</span>
<span>    margin: 12px 0;</span>
<span>    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .step-card .step-num {</span>
<span>    display: inline-block;</span>
<span>    background: #16a085;</span>
<span>    color: white;</span>
<span>    width: 28px;</span>
<span>    height: 28px;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 50%;</span>
<span>    text-align: center;</span>
<span>    line-height: 28px;</span>
<span>    font-weight: bold;</span>
<span>    margin-left: 10px;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .step-card .step-title {</span>
<span>    font-weight: bold;</span>
<span>    color: #16a085;</span>
<span>    font-size: 16px;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .step-card .step-desc {</span>
<span>    color: #555;</span>
<span>    margin-top: 8px;</span>
<span>    padding-right: 38px;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  #backToTop {</span>
<span>    position: fixed;</span>
<span>    bottom: 30px;</span>
<span>    left: 30px;</span>
<span>    background: #16a085;</span>
<span>    color: white;</span>
<span>    border: none;</span>
<span>    width: 45px;</span>
<span>    height: 45px;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 50%;</span>
<span>    cursor: pointer;</span>
<span>    font-size: 20px;</span>
<span>    box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(22, 160, 133, 0.4);</span>
<span>    display: none;</span>
<span>    z-index: 1000;</span>

<span>  #backToTop:hover { background: #138d75; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  @media print {</span>
<span>    body { background: white; font-size: 12px; }</span>

<span>  @media (max-width: 768px) {</span>

<span>  }</span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>style</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>head</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>container<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>header</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h1</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>🔒 فاز ۵: سیستم DataScope<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h1</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Row Level Security (RLS) — امنیت سطح رکورد<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>نسخه 1.0 — 1405/07/08<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span> <span class="token attr-name">style</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>margin-top: 20px; font-size: 14px;<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>🎉 این فاز کامل شده و تست شده است<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>header</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-title<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>DataScope چیه و چرا ساختیمش؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>تصور کن ۳۰۰ کاربر توی شرکت داری. اگه هر کاربری بتونه <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>همه‌ی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> رکوردها رو ببینه، آشغال میشه. مثلاً:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>اپراتور خط ۱ نباید بچ‌های خط ۲ رو ببینه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>کارشناس انبار نباید اطلاعات تولید رو ببینه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.DataScopes.DTOs;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class DataScopeService : IDataScopeService</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private const string CacheKeyPrefix = "DataScope_";</span>
<span>    private static readonly TimeSpan CacheDuration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);</span>
<span>    private const string AdministratorRoleName = "Administrator";</span>
<span></span>
<span>    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;</span>
<span>    private readonly ICurrentUserService _currentUser;</span>
<span>    private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public DataScopeService(</span>
<span>        ApplicationDbContext db,</span>
<span>        ICurrentUserService currentUser,</span>
<span>        IMemoryCache cache)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _db = db;</span>
<span>        _currentUser = currentUser;</span>
<span>        _cache = cache;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>DataScopeContext<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetCurrentScopeAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var ctx = new DataScopeContext();</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!_currentUser.IsAuthenticated || _currentUser.UserId == null)</span>
<span>            return ctx;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var userId = _currentUser.UserId.Value;</span>
<span>        var cacheKey = $"{CacheKeyPrefix}{userId}";</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (_cache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out DataScopeContext? cached) <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> cached != null)</span>
<span>            return cached;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var user = await _db.Users</span>
<span>            .IgnoreQueryFilters()</span>
<span>            .Where(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Id == userId)</span>
<span>            .Select(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new { u.Id, u.DepartmentId })</span>
<span>            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (user == null)</span>
<span>            return ctx;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        ctx.UserId = user.Id;</span>
<span>        ctx.UserDepartmentId = user.DepartmentId;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // با Join صریح — مطمئن‌تر از navigation property</span>
<span>        ctx.IsAdmin = await (</span>
<span>            from ur in _db.UserRoles</span>
<span>            join r in _db.Roles on ur.RoleId equals r.Id</span>
<span>            where ur.UserId == userId</span>
<span>               <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> r.Name == AdministratorRoleName</span>
<span>               <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> !r.IsDeleted</span>
<span>            select ur</span>
<span>        ).AnyAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (ctx.IsAdmin)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var deptIds = await _db.Departments</span>
<span>                .Where(d =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> !d.IsDeleted)</span>
<span>                .Select(d =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> d.Id)</span>
<span>                .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>            ctx.AccessibleDepartmentIds = deptIds.ToHashSet();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>        else if (user.DepartmentId.HasValue)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var allDepts = await _db.Departments</span>
<span>                .Where(d =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> !d.IsDeleted)</span>
<span>                .Select(d =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new DeptInfo { Id = d.Id, ParentId = d.ParentId })</span>
<span>                .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>            ctx.AccessibleDepartmentIds = GetAllDescendants(user.DepartmentId.Value, allDepts);</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        _cache.Set(cacheKey, ctx, CacheDuration);</span>
<span>        return ctx;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public Task InvalidateCacheAsync(int userId)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _cache.Remove($"{CacheKeyPrefix}{userId}");</span>
<span>        return Task.CompletedTask;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    private static HashSet<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>int<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetAllDescendants(int rootId, List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>DeptInfo<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> allDepts)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var result = new HashSet<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>int<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> { rootId };</span>
<span>        var queue = new Queue<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>int<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>        queue.Enqueue(rootId);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        while (queue.Count <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> 0)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var currentId = queue.Dequeue();</span>
<span></span>
<span>            var children = allDepts</span>
<span>                .Where(d =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> d.ParentId == currentId)</span>
<span>                .Select(d =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> d.Id)</span>
<span>                .ToList();</span>
<span></span>
<span>            foreach (var childId in children)</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                if (result.Add(childId))</span>
<span>                    queue.Enqueue(childId);</span>
<span>            }</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return result;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    private class DeptInfo</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        public int Id { get; set; }</span>
<span>        public int? ParentId { get; set; }</span>
<span>    }</span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>⚠️ نکته فنی مهم:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> چرا از Join صریح استفاده کردیم و نه <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>ur.Role.Name<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>؟ چون توی EF Core، وقتی Navigation Property رو صدا می‌زنی بدون Include، بعضی وقتا کار نمی‌کنه. Join صریح مطمئن‌تره.</span>

<span>using GelatinCapsule.Domain.Common;</span>

<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.DataScopes.Extensions;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public static class ScopedQueryExtensions</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    /// <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>summary</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    /// فیلترهای DataScope رو روی Query اعمال می‌کنه.</span>
<span>    /// - Admin: همه چیز</span>
<span>    /// - غیر Admin: رکوردهای خودش + رکوردهای واحدش</span>
<span>    /// <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>summary</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    public static IQueryable<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>T<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ApplyDataScope<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>T<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>(</span>
<span>        this IQueryable<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>T<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> query,</span>
<span>        DataScopeContext scope)</span>
<span>        where T : IScopedEntity</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        // کاربر لاگین نکرده → هیچی نمی‌بینه</span>
<span>        if (!scope.IsAuthenticated)</span>
<span>            return query.Where(e =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> false);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // ادمین همه چیز رو می‌بینه</span>
<span>        if (scope.IsAdmin)</span>
<span>            return query;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var userId = scope.UserId;</span>
<span>        var deptIds = scope.AccessibleDepartmentIds.ToList();</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return query.Where(e =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>            e.CreatedBy == userId ||</span>
<span>            (e.OwnerDepartmentId != null <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> deptIds.Contains(e.OwnerDepartmentId.Value)));</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>table</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>thead</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>tr</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>      <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>th</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>شرایط<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>th</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>      <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>th</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>نتیجه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>th</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>tr</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>thead</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>tbody</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>tr</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>      <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>کاربر لاگین نکرده<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>      <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>هیچ رکوردی برنمی‌گرده<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>tr</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>tr</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>      <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>ادمین (Administrator)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>      <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>همه رکوردها<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>tr</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>tr</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>      <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>غیر ادمین، رکورد ساخته‌شده توسط خودش<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>      <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>می‌بینه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>tr</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>tr</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>      <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>غیر ادمین، رکورد توی واحدش یا زیرمجموعه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>      <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>می‌بینه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>tr</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>tr</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>      <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>غیر ادمین، رکورد توی واحد دیگه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>td</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>private readonly PasswordHasher _hasher;</span>
<span>private readonly IDataScopeService _dataScope;</span>
<span>private readonly ICurrentUserService _currentUser;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public UsersController(</span>
<span>    ApplicationDbContext db,</span>
<span>    PasswordHasher hasher,</span>
<span>    IDataScopeService dataScope,</span>
<span>    ICurrentUserService currentUser)</span>
<span>{</span>

<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copyCode(this)<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Index(CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    // ۱. خواندن scope کاربر فعلی</span>
<span>    var scope = await _dataScope.GetCurrentScopeAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // ۲. اعمال فیلتر خودکار</span>
<span>    var users = await _db.Users</span>
<span>        .Include(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Department)</span>
<span>        .ApplyDataScope(scope)                     // 👈 فیلتر</span>
<span>        .OrderBy(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Username)</span>
<span>        .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>    return View(users);</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>var user = new User</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    Username = vm.Username.Trim(),</span>
<span>    PasswordHash = _hasher.Hash(vm.Password!),</span>
<span>    FullName = vm.FullName.Trim(),</span>
<span>    PersonnelCode = vm.PersonnelCode?.Trim(),</span>
<span>    NationalCode = vm.NationalCode?.Trim(),</span>
<span>    Email = vm.Email?.Trim(),</span>
<span>    Mobile = vm.Mobile?.Trim(),</span>
<span>    DepartmentId = vm.DepartmentId,</span>
<span>    OwnerDepartmentId = vm.DepartmentId,    // 👈 واحد مالک</span>

<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>script</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>function copyCode(btn) {</span>
<span>  const wrapper = btn.closest('.code-wrapper');</span>
<span>  const code = wrapper.querySelector('pre code');</span>
<span>  if (!code) return;</span>
<span></span>
<span>  const text = code.innerText;</span>
<span></span>
<span>  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() =&gt; {</span>
<span>    const originalHTML = btn.innerHTML;</span>
<span>    btn.innerHTML = '✅ کپی شد!';</span>
<span>    btn.classList.add('copied');</span>
<span></span>
<span>    setTimeout(() =&gt; {</span>
<span>      btn.innerHTML = originalHTML;</span>
<span>      btn.classList.remove('copied');</span>
<span>    }, 2000);</span>
<span>  }).catch(err =&gt; {</span>
<span>    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');</span>
<span>    textarea.value = text;</span>
<span>    document.body.appendChild(textarea);</span>
<span>    textarea.select();</span>
<span>    document.execCommand('copy');</span>
<span>    document.body.removeChild(textarea);</span>
<span></span>
<span>    const originalHTML = btn.innerHTML;</span>
<span>    btn.innerHTML = '✅ کپی شد!';</span>
<span>    btn.classList.add('copied');</span>
<span>    setTimeout(() =&gt; {</span>
<span>      btn.innerHTML = originalHTML;</span>
<span>      btn.classList.remove('copied');</span>
<span>    }, 2000);</span>
<span>  });</span>
<span>}</span>
<span></span>
<span>window.addEventListener('scroll', () =&gt; {</span>
<span>  const btn = document.getElementById('backToTop');</span>
<span>  if (window.scrollY &gt; 400) {</span>
<span>    btn.style.display = 'block';</span>
<span>  } else {</span>
<span>    btn.style.display = 'none';</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>});</span>
<span></span>
<span>document.querySelectorAll('.toc a').forEach(link =&gt; {</span>
<span>  link.addEventListener('click', (e) =&gt; {</span>
<span>    e.preventDefault();</span>
<span>    const target = document.querySelector(link.getAttribute('href'));</span>
<span>    if (target) {</span>
<span>      target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>  });</span>
<span>});</span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>script</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

punctuation">;</span></span>
<span>GO</span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token comment">-- اضافه کردن ماژول ملتینگ</span></span>
<span><span class="token keyword">INSERT</span> <span class="token keyword">INTO</span> Modules <span class="token punctuation">(</span>Code<span class="token punctuation">,</span> Name<span class="token punctuation">,</span> DisplayName<span class="token punctuation">,</span> SortOrder<span class="token punctuation">,</span> IsActive<span class="token punctuation">,</span> CreatedAt<span class="token punctuation">,</span> IsDeleted<span class="token punctuation">)</span></span>
<span><span class="token keyword">VALUES</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span>N<span class="token string">'Melting'</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> N<span class="token string">'Melting'</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> N<span class="token string">'ملتینگ (ذوب)'</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> <span class="token number">5</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> <span class="token number">1</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> GETUTCDATE<span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> <span class="token number">0</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>
<span>GO</span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token comment">-- اضافه کردن فرم اطلاعات شیفت</span></span>
<span><span class="token keyword">DECLARE</span> <span class="token variable">@MeltingModuleId</span> <span class="token keyword">INT</span> <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token keyword">SELECT</span> Id <span class="token keyword">FROM</span> Modules <span class="token keyword">WHERE</span> Code <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token string">'Melting'</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token keyword">INSERT</span> <span class="token keyword">INTO</span> Forms <span class="token punctuation">(</span>ModuleId<span class="token punctuation">,</span> Code<span class="token punctuation">,</span> DisplayName<span class="token punctuation">,</span> ControllerName<span class="token punctuation">,</span> ShowInMenu<span class="token punctuation">,</span> SupportsDataScope<span class="token punctuation">,</span> SortOrder<span class="token punctuation">,</span> IsActive<span class="token punctuation">,</span> CreatedAt<span class="token punctuation">,</span> IsDeleted<span class="token punctuation">)</span></span>
<span><span class="token keyword">VALUES</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token variable">@MeltingModuleId</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> N<span class="token string">'MeltingShiftInfo'</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> N<span class="token string">'اطلاعات شیفت ملتینگ'</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> N<span class="token string">'MeltingShiftInfo'</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> <span class="token number">1</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> <span class="token number">1</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> <span class="token number">1</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> <span class="token number">1</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> GETUTCDATE<span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> <span class="token number">0</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>
<span>GO</span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token comment">-- دادن دسترسی به نقش Administrator</span></span>
<span><span class="token keyword">DECLARE</span> <span class="token variable">@AdminRoleId</span> <span class="token keyword">INT</span> <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token keyword">SELECT</span> Id <span class="token keyword">FROM</span> Roles <span class="token keyword">WHERE</span> Name <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token string">'Administrator'</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>
<span><span class="token keyword">DECLARE</span> <span class="token variable">@MeltingModuleId2</span> <span class="token keyword">INT</span> <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token keyword">SELECT</span> Id <span class="token keyword">FROM</span> Modules <span class="token keyword">WHERE</span> Code <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token string">'Melting'</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>
<span><span class="token keyword">DECLARE</span> <span class="token variable">@ShiftFormId</span> <span class="token keyword">INT</span> <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token keyword">SELECT</span> Id <span class="token keyword">FROM</span> Forms <span class="token keyword">WHERE</span> Code <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token string">'MeltingShiftInfo'</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token comment">-- دسترسی به ماژول</span></span>
<span><span class="token keyword">INSERT</span> <span class="token keyword">INTO</span> RoleModuleAccesses <span class="token punctuation">(</span>RoleId<span class="token punctuation">,</span> ModuleId<span class="token punctuation">)</span></span>
<span><span class="token keyword">VALUES</span> <span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token variable">@AdminRoleId</span><span class="token punctuation">,</span> <span class="token variable">@MeltingModuleId2</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span></span>

### User

مورد اول نحوه ثبت تاریخ هستش
توی اکسس ما به این شکل تاریخ رو وارد میکنیم
14050606
یعنی بدون / ولی الان میخوام اینطوری نباشه و اگر کاربر 14050506 مثلا میزنه اینطوری توی این پوت قرار بگیره
1405/05/06 و اینطوری کاربر راحت تر وارد میکنه 
مورد بعدی که خیلی مهمه مثال بهت میگم میخوام مثلا سوپروایزر که باید اونجا اسم وارد کنیم کاربر نتونه اسم وارد کنه و مجبور باشه از لیستی که براش باز میشه انتخاب کنه یا حتی بقیه  مثل سرشیفت یاملتر کمک همشون اینطوری باشن تازه این سرشیفت و سوپروایز یا بقیه چیزا رو که میبینی  فقط برای ملتینگ نیست برای  تولید هم این عنواین شغلی رو داریم برای سورت هم داریم پس فقط مختس ملتینگ باشه
همینو فعلا درست کن تا ببینم بقیه مشلاکت چیه
